title: Fire at confectionery factory in Indonesia leaves at least three dead and dozens missing
summary_full: Relatives of the missing victims flocked to the factory’s entrance, seeking updates about their loved onesA fire at a confectionery factory west of Jakarta has killed three people with 36 remaining missing, an Indonesian rescue official says.Drone footage showed large parts of the factory destroyed, with the roof collapsed in places and smoke still rising from the complex. Photos and videos shared by rescuers show officers entering the charred building in search of the missing victims on Sunday, with small fires still burning in some spots. Continue reading...
